name: Jitsi Meet
author: Jitsi
description: Jitsi Meet is an open-source video conferencing solution. This Runtipi package runs the Jitsi Meet web frontend, Prosody XMPP server, Jicofo conference focus, and Jitsi Videobridge with Traefik-managed web routing and a direct UDP media port.

form_fields.label: JVB advertised IP(s)
form_fields.hint: Publicly reachable JVB address. IPv4, IPv6, or comma-separated addresses. Do not enter a private LAN address.

form_fields.label: Enable authentication
form_fields.hint: Require users to authenticate before creating or joining meetings.

form_fields.label: TURN server host
form_fields.hint: Hostname or IP address of the external TURN server. Leave empty to disable TURN.

form_fields.label: TURN server port
form_fields.hint: TURN server port for UDP or TCP.

form_fields.label: TURN transport
form_fields.hint: Transport protocol used by TURN. Supported values are udp, tcp, or udp,tcp.

form_fields.label: TURN credentials
form_fields.hint: Static TURN credential/secret when using TURN_CREDENTIALS.

form_fields.label: TURN username
form_fields.hint: TURN username. Use this instead of TURN_CREDENTIALS when your TURN server uses username/password authentication.

form_fields.label: TURN password
form_fields.hint: TURN password for the TURN username.

form_fields.label: TURN TLS host
form_fields.hint: TURN-over-TLS hostname. Leave empty if you are not using TURN over TLS.
